source: his 2026-11-02 07:38: "missi9n idea, signal traces / mission board / Pirates have been attacking traders, visit 3 sights to triangulate there based and then wipe them out"; 07:42, option 1: "do option 1 yeah, 3 might feel like a chore abyway"
_note: SIGNAL TRACES, his idea. A Delve has three places at most (main, second, third), so his three trace sites plus the base would be four. His pick: TWO traces, which is honest triangulation (two bearings cross at a point), then the base. A third trace waits on a fourth place, Eliza's, and he called three a likely chore.

The traces are the raids' own leftovers: a trader's terminal where they hit her, still logging. The two reads are a group (any order), so no line says first or second; the base gets its marker only when both are done.
The base is pinned to pirates at the accept (place.faction, plan OT-01), so its residents are the pirates the words name. Fleet members: his 10-31 check stops those missions starting.

Vic Tarrant's register on the speaker (a convoy master): level, dry, unimpressed. Voice borrowed until his ear casts it. No names, places, factions or currency in any voiced line; 'pirates' is a role.

DOES NOT LINT YET, on purpose (2026-11-02): a board has main and a remote second only, no <ThirdPlace> token, and the Crimson pin is refused until the member gate exists. His 07:52: "ask Eliza to look at N places. should be possible". Letter: home-office office/correspondence/2026-11-02-jessica-eliza-n-places.md.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Trace the pirates hitting traders in this system, then clear their base. Payment on contract completion."

LEVEL AND DISTANCE 2026-11-11 (his: 'some quests shouldnt be given to a level 1 player' and 'not sending them across the whole map just to deliver a coffee'; Eliza's minLevel and place.parsecs, FrankyCLI 3c81f6a): minLevel 15: a pirate base at the end of a trace; parsecs 12: an easy or med job stays within about 40 systems of him.

place._themes: THREE DISJOINT POOLS: a trader hit in the open (natural), a trading stop hit (quiet), the base (built, hostile).

prose.name: Hunt: Signal Traces
prose.briefing: Pirates have been hitting traders in this system. Two of the traders they hit left terminals logging at the <SecondPlace> and the <ThirdPlace>, and between them the logs should point at the base.
prose.card: Pirates are hitting traders in this system. Two of their victims left terminals logging, and between them they should point at the base. Clear it.

broadcast: You've found where they hit. They take the cargo and leave the terminals, because nobody wants a terminal. Read this one, then the other, and we'll see where the two bearings cross.
_speech: Vic: dry, unimpressed, the joke is in the plain fact. The broadcast plays at the first trace he reaches, either one, so it says 'this one' and 'the other'.

beats.name: Trader's Terminal
beats.objective: Read the traders' terminals at the <SecondPlace> and the <ThirdPlace>

message.title: Trader's Terminal
message.text: The tracking log is still running. The raiders came in fast on one bearing, and went back out the same way with the cargo.

beats.journal: I read the trader's terminal at the <SecondPlace>. It gives one bearing for the pirates.
say: Bearing logged. On its own, it points at half the system.

beats.name: Trader's Terminal

message.title: Trader's Terminal
message.text: Somebody kept the log going through the whole raid. The bearing they left on is the clearest thing in it.

beats.journal: I read the trader's terminal at the <ThirdPlace>. It gives one bearing for the pirates.
say: Bearing logged. Wherever it crosses the other one, that's where they live.

beats.objective: Clear the pirates from their base at the <Place>
beats.journal: The two bearings crossed at the <Place>, and I cleared the pirates out of it.
say: So that's where they were. The convoys can stop flying the long way round.
